rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-26 - t13-en-data-extraction [ses_f21254d6effeXAhSFcQIGXXhTi].md:L5368] **Consequence you should know: the page is still 726 lines and therefore still over the 500-line convention.** `banking.astro` has the same structural issue (689 lines, 423-line style), so this is a pattern-level conflict between the 500-line rule and the style-parity guard, not something I can solve within two files. The clean fix is a shared `<style>` partial or a component, which needs a decision outside my file ownership.

nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-27 - t2-platform-release-manifests [ses_f1da1a2bcffeLJlpNkCN55363n].md:L4065] Root `pub_date` **changed** `2026-09-26T22:14:25.723Z` → `2026-09-22T09:25:59.000Z`, and root `version` `0.6.849` → `0.6.838`. That is the design's "root stays the Windows compatibility view". The old root `pub_date` was provably *not* a Windows date: it is 11 minutes after the `v0.6.849` Linux tag, i.e. the last aggregate-write time, so keeping it would have labelled the Windows release with the Linux publish time.
